tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /smyug la khu spe chos sde'i gzhi bdag thog rgod bkra shis kyis gsol kha thog rgod rab dga' bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ smyug la khu spe chos sde'i gzhi bdag thog rgod bkra shis mchod tshul ni/ zlum gtor sha rgyan can/ phye mar/ khrag chang / sha hrug rnams snod so sor blugs pa dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bsangs dud bcas bshams la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsum/ hrīḥ thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa/ /byu ru'i mdog can pad ma'i dbyug tho 'dzin/ /rta mchog zhal gyi sgra yis bdud 'joms pa'i/ /khro bo'i dbang por rang nyid gsal bar gyur/ /oṃ las chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings/ /āḥlas rin po che las grub pa'i snod/ /hūm̐ las ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bcud/ /hoḥlas mchod gtor bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /kyai 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rnam rol chen mo 'dir/ /so so'i dkar nag las kyis 'brel pa las/ /ma dag rigs drug srid pa bar do dang / /dag pa snod bcud yon tan dpal du shar/ /de las 'khor dang 'das zhes cha 'dzin ltar/ /'khor ba ltar na bkra shis thog rgod zhes/ /bar srid 'jig rten dregs byed tshul 'dzin cing / /yang dag khro chags gzugs 'dzin bstan srung sku/ /khu spe bshad sgrub lha mi'i sder bcas pa/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i dregs pa mthu rtsal can/ /'khor dang bcas pa rang gi dam tshig ltar/ /gtor ma 'dod dgu'i lhun po 'di bzhes shig /phye phud dpal 'byor rgya mtshoྎ /dam nyams khrag gi chu klungྎ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsiྎ /dgra bgegs sha rus phung poྎ /mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldanྎ /zhabs bsil khrus kyi rgya mtshoྎ /me tog srid zhi rab mdzesྎ /bdug spos dri zhim nags tshalྎ /snang gsal mun pa kun 'jomsྎ /dri chab bde ba'i dpal sderྎ /zhal zas ro brgya ldan paྎ /rol mo snyan dbyangs khor yugྎ /gzhan yang dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/

/mthu ldan gang zhig dgyes pa'i mchod sprin tshogs/ /bzhed dgu'i bang mdzod nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'bul/ /khyed kyi mthu dang bdag gi lhag bsam dang / /ting 'dzin sngags brgya rgyu 'bras bden pa yis/ /ji ltar bzhed bzhin thugs dam bskang gyur cig /bcas dang rang bzhin gyis bsdus nyes tshogs dang / /khyad par srid zhi'i dregs pa dam can dang / /'gal 'khrul nyes kun nongs pas bshags lags na/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i dbyings su zhi gyur cig /khyed la bdag gis gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /spyir gyi bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde sgrubs/ /bye brag smyug la khu spe'i chos grwa 'dir/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang mchod sprin 'phel/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas sgra dbyangs sgrog /khrims ldan dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /dge legs dpal 'byor rnam sras bang mdzod bzhin/ /dad 'dun 'khor tshogs rgyal dang bsgyur rgyal ltar/ /tshe dpal la sogs srid pa'i dngos grub dang / /lung rtogs yon tan sa lam mthar phyin sogs/ /zhi ba'i 'bras bzang ma lus kun 'grub mdzod/ /phyogs 'dir gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba kun/ /mthu ldan gzhi bdag khyed kyi zas su 'bul/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs da lta nyid du zo/ /mdor na sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag bzhes/ /da bcol bstan 'gror dge ba'i phrin las kun/ /gang dang gang du ci dang ci bcol ba/ /thogs med myur du sgrubs shig drag shugs can/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin la gus/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub la thogs mi mnga'/ /chos grwa chen po gces par skyong ba yi/ /mthu ldan thog rgod bkra shis 'khor bcas bstod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis/

/phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye dgu yongs la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces khu spe'i gzhi bdag mchod tshul 'di yang de ga'i rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mgyogs par sbyar// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ smyug la khu spe chos sde'i gzhi bdag thog rgod bkra shis kyi gsol kha/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
